inputSchemaCoverage: Command envelopes and documented nested fields; adapter, revision, applicability and physical validation remain authoritative.

operations.description: Start or retrieve an idempotent two-saved-case comparison PNG or orbit/time/deformation WebM/GIF export.

animation.description: WebM/GIF; orbit moves the shared camera at fixed panel times; time fixes the camera and traverses an explicit physical range.

startTimeSeconds.description: Required for time WebM/GIF only; physical range start, less than endTimeSeconds.

endTimeSeconds.description: Required for time WebM/GIF only; physical range end.

sideEffects: Renders two saved cases to a retained PNG or orbit/time/deformation WebM/GIF and restores the original viewer; does not restore saved project inputs or download files.
limitations: Argument envelope only; runtime validation remains authoritative.

Format defaults to PNG with existing request identity; comparison-only GIF supports orbit/time/deformation,24 fixed frames (orbit phase i/24; time/deformation i/23 include both endpoints),640x320,RGB332 256 colors and seconds1-15 integer delays totaling seconds*100 centiseconds; no MediaRecorder is required. Single-view orbit GIF uses the separate singleOrbitGifExport capability; single-view time/deformation GIF remain unsupported. Comparison time WebM uses a separate comparisonTimeWebmExport capability: VP8 fixed frames N=min(seconds*24,120), physical phase i/(N-1), integer-microsecond presentation intervals total seconds, all encoded timestamps and strict-demux decoded timestamps verified including the endpoint. Missing APIs/codec or verification failure refuses the artifact; no realtime fallback. Orbit/default and deformation WebM retain realtime target24fps without guaranteed frame count. Selected physical times remain fixed throughout the orbit; browser recording support is observed through exportCapabilities. Time mode requires startTimeSeconds < endTimeSeconds within both stored histories, rejects timeSeconds/static/final-only fields, and uses nearest stored frames with actual times/offsets and no interpolation. Its camera and all-period common color range stay fixed. Deformation mode requires two linear-elastic cases, displacement/stress and positive explicit deformScale without any time arguments; fixed camera/result/color range, linear visualization multiplier 0 to deformScale, never a physical load history.
Exactly two distinct stable caseId/expectedRevision pairs from caseList; stale references and invalid settings are refused.

PNG/orbit with stored thermal temperature/acoustic time axes require timeSeconds; time WebM/GIF uses explicit physical start/end instead. Nearest stored frames are used with actual times and signed offsets, without interpolation. Thermal heat flux is final-only.

Uses the shared visual-export queue and existing exportStatus/exportArtifact/cancelExport/releaseExport transport and limits. Camera and deformation scale default to the captured current viewer when omitted.
